_what: Performance budget for the guard in PERF_BUDGET_GUARD.md (task 220). Read by tools/overnight/run-budget-check.sh (task 230; owner Q-AO (b), N = 5). The baseline is a RATCHET: the check fails when a number gets worse than the baseline by more than its tolerance; the targets are reported as distance only (today every arm is 3x over them, so failing on them would fail every run and teach everyone to ignore it).
machine: MacBook Air M1, 8 GB, fanless; AC power; warm steady state (one discarded warm-up launch first)

settings._why: Play's own look (owner 2026-11-16 Q-AN: keep the look). 219 showed the presets change memory, not time (Low 108.0 vs High 111.4 ms), so the check runs what the owner plays.
settings.upscaler: fsr3 pinned at 432 rows (play's dyn floor; dyn sits there whenever a frame is > 30 ms)
settings.flags: tools/play-flags.sh ($PLAY_SETTINGS_FLAGS): trees, shells, torch flood, sky fill 2, FSR 3
settings.launch: run-budget-check.sh: $PLAY_SETTINGS_FLAGS -quality high -renderrows 432 -shellwait 60, then each launch's flags and -costarms from 'launches' below (task 235)

targets._note: Reported as 'distance to target', never a FAIL until the baseline is inside them.

hard_limits._note: These DO fail the check regardless of the baseline.

tolerance._basis: 212's two launches (Logs/costsplit_2026-11-15_143504.txt, _160531.txt): FULL p50 at walk_near 104.3-108.2 ms across 12 F passes (spread ~4 ms, ~4 %); lighting deltas F - X repeat within ~2-3 ms. 224: process peak launch-to-launch spread ~+-50 MB.

paths.walk_near: MODE=walk arc (task 212) heading straight away from the sun; the arc depends on the sun azimuth, so at -startsun 16 it is a different arc than at noon. Flood ~0 by day (task 229)
paths.torch: -costpaths torch (task 151): night 0.50 h, 28-32 torches round a still pose. The scene's FULL is the OLD point lights; the check times arms tf_on (play's torch flood) and tl_none (no torch light): night play p50 = tf_on, torch_flood step = tf_on - tl_none (task 230)
paths.forest_eye: -costfixed forest (task 210/219), eye height -- dense trees; at 16 deg morning sun the worst frame of the day cycle (233: +27 ms vs noon). WORST-CASE since task 235 (its streaming deficit is reported, not a failure by itself)
paths._pose_note: forest_eye_pose and jungle_eye_pose are pinned here (copied from Logs/TerrainGen/trees210/poses.txt) so the check's poses cannot drift with that file.
paths.jungle_eye: -costfixed jungle (task 210/232), eye height, noon -- the heaviest GPU-pool pose (pool full, refusals; streaming deficit ~950)

worst_case._why: Owner 2026-11-17 (task 235, "I want 1 for now"): judge performance on WORST-CASE poses, not noon. A low sun and torches both occur in play, so a gain that only shows at noon / with no torch near is not a gain for the 30 fps target. The verdict counts the worst-case rows; the noon rows are a control.
worst_case._cost: forest_eye and jungle_eye keep a streaming deficit, so each run there waits NearSettle's 180 s cap (~3.7 min a run; runs = 1 + 3 x arms): those launches time only the arms the table needs. Day flood is not timed (229: FULL line says skip = 0 by construction). rest = FULL - sun - sky fill - flood.

poses._note: night play = tf_on (the scene FULL is the old point lights); flood = tf_on - tl_none; sun / sky fill = their arm vs that point-light FULL

steps.name: torch_flood
steps._8_17: Reserve: torches at night (share is for the NIGHT path; day share 0)
steps._note: timed at night only (tf_on - tl_none); by day 0 by construction since 229 (FULL line flood skip)

steps.name: shells
steps._note: timed at walk_near_16 only (cheap pose); elsewhere inside rest

steps.name: ceiling
steps._note: timed at walk_near_16 only; sky probe + sun + shells off together

_steps_rule: A look/content task that adds a pass appends a step here with its off_arm (a -costarms name it registers) and the share it takes (from 'shading/post' 5.0 ms or a named reserve, per AMENDMENT_8_17 section 3). Task 235: also add its off_arm to the launches whose poses it draws at (PERF_BUDGET.json launches).

baseline.settings: [play flags] -quality high -renderrows 432 -shellwait 60; walk: -startsun 16 -costtimedpaths walk_near -costarms skyfill0,sun_off,shells_off,ceiling,startsun_off | forest: -startsun 16 -costfixed forest_eye -costtimedpaths forest_eye -costarms skyfill0,sun_off,startsun_off | jungle: -startsun 0 -costfixed jungle_eye -costtimedpaths jungle_eye -costarms skyfill0,sun_off | night: -costpaths torch -costarms tf_on,tl_none,skyfill0,sun_off

previous_baselines._note: v1 (noon walk_near) provisional baseline from 212 + 219, replaced by task 235's worst-case v2
